message:
This PR implements the channels extension feature that allows users to add custom channel sources, making them visible on both the web dashboard and IPTV clients. The implementation includes a performance-optimized startup loading system with efficient O(1) channel lookups and comprehensive warnings for excessive channel configurations.

## Overview

Users can now define custom channels in JSON or YAML configuration files that will be seamlessly integrated with existing JioTV channels. Custom channels support all existing features including filtering by language/category and M3U playlist generation.

## Performance Optimization

The implementation uses a startup loading system that loads custom channels once during application initialization, eliminating expensive file I/O operations on every `Live()` request. The cache features:

- **Startup Loading**: Channels are loaded once during application startup via `InitCustomChannels()`
- **Thread Safety**: Protected with read-write mutex for concurrent access  
- **Cache Management**: Functions to reload (`ReloadCustomChannels()`) and clear cache when needed
- **Error Resilience**: Graceful fallback when files are missing or invalid
- **Clean Code**: Removed goto statements in favor of early returns for better maintainability
- **Efficient Lookups**: Map-based channel lookups provide O(1) time complexity instead of O(n) linear search

## Performance Warnings for Excessive Channels

The implementation now includes comprehensive warnings when users configure more than **1000 custom channels**:

- **Automatic Detection**: Warns users during loading, caching, and reload operations
- **Detailed Impact Information**: Explains specific performance consequences including slower operations, increased memory usage, longer startup times, and UI responsiveness issues
- **Best Practice Guidance**: Provides recommendations for optimizing large channel configurations
- **Documentation**: Updated with performance considerations section explaining the 1000-channel limit

## Configuration

The feature is enabled by setting the `custom_channels_file` option in your configuration file or using the `JIOTV_CUSTOM_CHANNELS_FILE` environment variable:

```yaml
# jiotv-config.yml
custom_channels_file: "./configs/custom-channels.yml"
```

```bash
# Environment variable
export JIOTV_CUSTOM_CHANNELS_FILE="./configs/custom-channels.json"
```

## Custom Channels Format

Both JSON and YAML formats are supported:

```json
{
  "channels": [
    {
      "id": "custom_news_1",
      "name": "Sample News Channel",
      "url": "https://example.com/news/playlist.m3u8",
      "logo_url": "https://example.com/logos/news.png",
      "category": 12,
      "language": 6,
      "is_hd": true
    }
  ]
}
```

```yaml
channels:
  - id: custom_entertainment_1
    name: Sample Entertainment Channel
    url: https://example.com/entertainment/playlist.m3u8
    logo_url: https://example.com/logos/entertainment.png
    category: 5   # Entertainment
    language: 1   # Hindi
    is_hd: false
```

## Features

- **Seamless Integration**: Custom channels appear alongside JioTV channels in the web interface
- **IPTV Support**: Custom channels are included in generated M3U playlists (`/playlist.m3u`)
- **Direct Streaming**: Access custom channels via `/live/custom_channel_id.m3u8`
- **Filtering Compatibility**: Custom channels work with existing language and category filters
- **Multi-format Support**: Both JSON and YAML configuration file formats supported
- **Error Handling**: Graceful fallback when custom channels file is missing or invalid
- **Backward Compatibility**: Feature is optional and doesn't affect existing functionality
- **High Performance**: Startup loading eliminates file I/O overhead during requests
- **Efficient Lookups**: O(1) map-based channel lookups instead of O(n) linear search
- **Clean Code**: Improved maintainability with removal of goto statements
- **Performance Monitoring**: Comprehensive warnings and guidance for large channel configurations

## Performance Improvements

The Live function previously performed a linear search through all custom channels for each request:

```go
// Before: O(n) linear search
for _, channel := range customChannels {
    if channel.ID == channelID {
        // Handle custom channel
    }
}

// After: O(1) hash map lookup
if channel, exists := getCustomChannelByID(channelID); exists {
    // Handle custom channel
}
```

This optimization provides significant performance benefits when dealing with large numbers of custom channels.

## Usage Examples

- **Web Interface**: Navigate to `http://localhost:5001` to see custom channels in the main list
- **Direct Stream**: `http://localhost:5001/live/custom_news_1.m3u8`
- **IPTV Playlist**: `http://localhost:5001/channels?type=m3u` includes custom channels
- **Filtered View**: `http://localhost:5001/?language=6&category=12` works with custom channels

## Implementation Details

- Extended the configuration system with `CustomChannelsFile` field
- Added `CustomChannel` and `CustomChannelsConfig` types for structured parsing
- Enhanced `television.Channels()` function to merge custom channels with API results
- Modified `television.Live()` function to handle custom channel streaming with optimized lookups
- Implemented `InitCustomChannels()` function called during application startup from `handlers.Init()`
- Added `getCustomChannelByID()` function for efficient O(1) channel lookups using hash map
- Replaced goto statements with early returns for improved code readability
- Added cache management functions for reload and clear operations
- Updated all caching functions to maintain both slice and map data structures for different use cases
- Implemented comprehensive performance warnings with `maxRecommendedChannels` constant (1000)
- Enhanced logging to warn users about performance implications of excessive channels
- Updated documentation with performance considerations and best practices
- Comprehensive test coverage for JSON/YAML parsing, error scenarios, caching functionality, efficient lookups, and excessive channel warnings
- Complete documentation with field descriptions, category/language ID mappings, and performance guidelines

The implementation maintains full backward compatibility and follows existing codebase patterns. Custom channels are loaded once at startup for optimal performance while the server continues to work normally even if the custom channels file is missing or contains errors. Users are now properly warned about potential performance impacts when configuring large numbers of custom channels.

Fixes #449.
